views: view1: ขยายบันได 1 ชั้นล่าง - ชั้น 2 (two flights + landing) — section (this file)
warnings: Stair 1 between the ground floor and floor 2 (ขยายบันได 1, 1/25), two flights with a landing (ชานพัก 1). The plan marks the stair opening 'บันได 1' (S-04..S-06 slab files) — element_id keeps that printed label; one entry per flight, level names the flight (spec section 8).
Flight rebar is recorded as bar_layers with the printed callouts; the main bar of the upper flight is hand-corrected to 'DB 12' (flag).
Riser/tread from the 'ขยายลูกขั้นบันได' detail on S-15 (0.175 / 0.275, nosing 0.025) — printed on that sheet, applied to both stair sheets.
The section's bottom chain 'ประมาณ 1.93m | 3.57 | 2.50' (5.50 B-C + A-B) positions beam G3 6.07 from row A; it is recorded in the grid master (line B''''').
Landings/hall slabs S3, S4, S5, S6 and beams B2, B3, B6, G3, G4, G6, G7, G9 drawn in the section are detailed on S-13/S-16/S-18.
